parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: The base of the clock is made of wood, providing structural support and stability for the entire clock assembly.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the clock body and glass cover, ensuring the clock stands upright and stable on a surface.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Clock Body
parts.Basic_description: The clock body is made of brass and includes the clock face, hands, and pendulum mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the timekeeping mechanism and displays the time through the clock face and hands.
parts.Movement_description: Contains moving components such as the pendulum and clock hands that operate continuously.

parts.name: Glass Cover
parts.Basic_description: The glass cover is a transparent dome that encloses the clock body, protecting it from dust and damage.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a protective barrier while allowing visibility of the clock face and internal components.
parts.Movement_description: It is removable but remains stationary during normal operation.
